lines: She gave you the Seal. Right. Then I'll tell you what I told her.
The Concord took soundings off my pier for six weeks. Always after dark.
A survey's a survey. But an honest one doesn't need the dark.
Brackwater. Forty boats, two of them working.
Not for want of crew. For want of a channel worth putting a boat down.
Mabry's out on the pier. She's been out on the pier since Tuesday.

bw_netter: Flats are heaving. Everything that lives deep has come up onto the mud.
My mother would have called that a gift year. It isn't. It's a run.
Things run from something. Nobody down here finishes that sentence.
bw_child: Dad says the sea's holding its breath.
So I asked what happens when it lets go.
He didn't answer. So I asked louder. He still didn't answer.

lines: Beat Mabry, did you. She'll be insufferable. She's always insufferable.
Coast road runs north when you're ready. Mind the lanes on your way out.
The middle one's deep. It doesn't forgive and it doesn't warn you.
Waystation west, provisioner east, Bastion at the end of the pier.
Mind the lanes either side of the hall when you get there.
The middle one's deep. It doesn't forgive and it doesn't warn you.
You've spoken to the Director. Good. Then I don't have to perform.
Here's the part she leaves out, because it doesn't persuade anybody.
We don't know what happens to everything that migrates once the current stops.
We have models. They disagree with each other. Loudly.
Depth soundings. Standard work. Very dull.
No, I can't give you the numbers. No, that isn't sinister, it's a form.
...I'd like it to be dull. I'd like that a great deal.

bw_sailor: Sixty years I read this channel. Currents, colour, the way the birds sit on it.
Now it's flat as a table, and I've never had to read a table before.
A flat sea isn't a calm sea. A flat sea is a held one, and something's holding it.
bw_house: My husband fished the deep channel. Thirty-one years.
He went out one morning in spring and the water never moved the boat. Not once.
He came home, sat down, and never went out again. He was gone by midsummer.
Storms never frightened him. Stillness did. I've come round to his way of thinking.
